async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog link to open the dropdown menu
    catalog_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog")
    await catalog_link.click()
    # Wait a moment for the menu to appear

    products_link = page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Products")
    await products_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the Products page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
